change/files.author_gloss: converts files between formats (JPG/PNG/WEBP/GIF, MP4/WEBM, audio).
change/files.excludes: extract text (-> read_files); decompress archives (-> compress_files).

change/pulls.author_gloss: opera su una pull request (es. merge).

compress/files.author_gloss: compress files into a new zip/tar/gz archive.

compute/entries.author_gloss: compute an aggregated value (max/min/avg/sum/count) on entries.
compute/entries.excludes: sort the list (-> sort_entries); filter by criteria (-> filter_entries).

compute/files.author_gloss: computes source-code LOC statistics, walking directory trees in parallel.

compute/signatures.author_gloss: compute or classify a signature; it can idempotently apply the safety seed.
compute/signatures.excludes: query lists (-> get_signatures); modify user curation (-> set_signatures).

consult/frontier.author_gloss: consult an expert oracle for deep analysis.

create/calendars.author_gloss: create a NEW Google calendar container (not an event).
create/calendars.excludes: event/appointment -> create_events; does not list calendars; delete -> delete_calendars.

create/dirs.excludes: delete (-> delete_dirs); search (-> find_dirs); list (-> list_dirs).

create/events.excludes: from web/text FIRST extract_entries; relative dates FIRST get_now; read -> read_events.

create/files.excludes: writing to existing doc (-> write_files_doc); creating sheets (-> create_files_spreadsheet).

create/issues.author_gloss: crea una nuova issue su un repo GitHub.

delete/calendars.author_gloss: delete Google calendar containers (DESTRUCTIVE: also removes the events inside); accepts the NAME.
delete/calendars.excludes: deleting an EVENT -> delete_events; create -> create_calendars.

delete/credentials.author_gloss: delete credentials from storage (purge or bindings).
delete/credentials.excludes: read (-> find_credentials) or save (-> set_credentials); do not use bindings with all=true.

delete/dirs.excludes: create (-> create_dirs); list (-> list_dirs); find (-> find_dirs).

delete/events.author_gloss: delete calendar events, by ids or time window.
delete/events.excludes: read_events first when time_window is enough; create -> create_events.

delete/files.author_gloss: delete files after a verified backup.
delete/files.excludes: directories (-> delete_dirs), symlinks, or moves (-> move_files).

delete/images.author_gloss: delete the persistent unified image index.
delete/images.excludes: delete actual photos (-> delete_files); rebuild (-> create_images_indices).

delete/persons.author_gloss: deletes persons/enrollment from the biometric registry (purge or by name/slug).
delete/persons.excludes: credentials/tokens (-> delete_credentials); photos on filesystem (-> delete_files).

delete/tasks.author_gloss: Cancella/ferma un TASK RICORRENTE / PROMEMORIA / TIMER schedulato.

describe/numbers.author_gloss: calculates descriptive statistics on a list of numbers.
describe/numbers.excludes: aggregate record fields (-> compute_entries); text or images.

filter/lists.author_gloss: ops between TWO lists (A=from_step, B=with_step) on on_keys; delta = monitor dedup.

filter/texts.excludes: read files (-> read_files); search directories (-> find).

find/contacts.author_gloss: search contacts in an external address book by name/email/phone.
find/contacts.excludes: read one contact (-> read_contacts); identity profiles (-> read_persons).

find/credentials.author_gloss: lists configured accounts and services (mail, api, cloud): metadata-only credentials.
find/credentials.excludes: reading account mail (-> read_messages); secret values (-> set_credentials).

find/dirs.author_gloss: find directories and compute aggregate metadata with a parallel recursive walk.
find/dirs.excludes: list files (-> find_files); directory contents (-> list_dirs).

find/events.author_gloss: find free slots in the calendar.
find/events.excludes: read events (-> read_events); create events (-> create_events).

find/files.author_gloss: search files by pattern with a parallel recursive walk.
find/files.excludes: list_dirs+filter_entries; get_files (ID lookup); exact duplicate search (-> find_files_hash).

find/images.author_gloss: search indexed photos by content, person or face.
find/images.excludes: EXIF of known paths -> get_files; files of a folder by path -> find_files.

find/issues.author_gloss: elenca le issue (segnalazioni/bug/ticket) di un repo GitHub.
find/issues.excludes: usare per pull request (-> find_pulls_github); omettere repo.

find/packages.author_gloss: finds an executable command in the system PATH.
find/packages.excludes: querying a package-manager database; reading files (-> read_files).

find/persons.author_gloss: search photos of a registered person.

find/places.author_gloss: find real-world places by text query or coordinates.
find/places.excludes: read files (-> read_files); get data by known IDs (-> get_places).

find/pulls.author_gloss: elenca le pull request (richieste di merge) di un repo GitHub.
find/pulls.excludes: usare per issue (-> find_issues_github); omettere repo.

find/urls.author_gloss: find and discover URLs and documents on the web.

get/files.author_gloss: gets size, dates, and EXIF for KNOWN files.
get/files.excludes: search by subject -> find_images_indices; by pattern -> find_files.

get/images.author_gloss: gets unified image-index status for one corpus or all corpora.
get/images.excludes: build indexes (-> create_images_indices); search photos (-> find_images_indices).

get/inputs.excludes: deriving observable data (-> find_*/read_*); executing commands (-> admin).

get/location.author_gloss: tells where the current actor is.
get/location.excludes: geocode a place name -> find_places; look for nearby places -> get_places; read the history.

get/now.author_gloss: gets the current date and time in the configured timezone or an explicit IANA zone.
get/now.excludes: read calendar events or infer a timezone from a place.

get/persons.excludes: profiles -> read_persons; photos -> find_persons_indices; enrollment -> set_persons.

get/places.author_gloss: gets place name from GPS coordinates.

get/processes.excludes: scheduled tasks (-> list_tasks), file metadata (-> get_files), time or location (-> get_now/get_location).

get/proposals.author_gloss: reads introvertive proposals, including historical categories.
get/proposals.excludes: search data (-> find); filter entries already read (-> filter).

get/signatures.excludes: compute signatures (-> compute_signatures); modify curation (-> set_signatures).

get/urls.excludes: find URLs (-> find_urls); read HTML (-> read_urls_html).

group/entries.author_gloss: merges and deduplicates entries from multiple lists.
group/entries.excludes: group by value or aggregate (-> compute_entries); filter (-> filter_entries).

list/dirs.author_gloss: lists directories and files; recursive mode walks subdirectories in parallel.

list/skills.author_gloss: Elenca le SKILL di Metnos (gruppi di capacità attivabili: foto, mail, web, geo, calendario, github, frontier + core) con stato ATTIVA/DISATTIVA/DORMIENTE e prerequisiti.

list/tasks.author_gloss: Elenca i TASK RICORRENTI / PROMEMORIA / TIMER schedulati (NON processi di sistema, NON eventi calendar).

login/session.author_gloss: Esegue il login al form web di un dominio gia' registrato (credentials.store(domain, payload)) e salva il cookie session in '~/.config/metnos/cookies/<domain>.txt' (formato Mozilla, mode 0600).

move/files.author_gloss: move or rename files in batch.

move/messages.author_gloss: move messages between folders or labels.
move/messages.excludes: change labels only (-> set_messages) or delete.

read/contacts.author_gloss: read one contact from external address book.

read/events.excludes: read mail or create events (-> read_messages, create_events).

read/files.author_gloss: reads mixed PDF/DOCX/XLSX/CSV and computes SHA-256 hash signatures.

read/issues.author_gloss: legge UNA issue (contenuto + commenti) per numero.
read/issues.excludes: usare per elencare (-> find_issues_github); omettere number.

read/messages.author_gloss: reads IMAP messages combining time and text filters.
read/messages.excludes: sending (-> send_messages) or moving messages (-> move_messages).

read/persons.excludes: biometric registry -> get_persons; photos -> find_persons_indices; changes or credentials.

read/pulls.author_gloss: legge UNA pull request (contenuto + diff) per numero.
read/pulls.excludes: usare per elencare (-> find_pulls_github); omettere number.

read/tasks.author_gloss: elenca le run dei workflow GitHub Actions di un repo.

read/urls.author_gloss: reads web pages and extracts main text; PDF URLs extracted as text automatically.
read/urls.excludes: PDF-only lists (-> read_urls_pdf); URL discovery (-> find_urls).

reply/messages.author_gloss: Risponde in-thread a uno o piu' messaggi (Gmail).

send/messages.author_gloss: send email/Telegram and reply in-thread on Gmail.

set/messages.author_gloss: add or remove labels on identified Gmail messages.
set/messages.excludes: list labels without a target; move folders -> move_messages.

set/persons.author_gloss: enroll a person in the named registry.

set/pulls.author_gloss: aggiorna stato/titolo/reviewer di una pull request.

set/signatures.author_gloss: sets or removes signatures from user curation.

set/skills.author_gloss: Abilita o disabilita una SKILL (gruppo di capacità) per nome.

set/tasks.author_gloss: Cambia lo stato di un task ricorrente esistente.

share/files.author_gloss: grants access permissions to Drive files without duplicating them.

sort/entries.excludes: persistent order; aggregates -> compute_entries; filters -> filter_entries.

get/approval.author_gloss: human consent (Approve/Reject), then runs the executor.
get/approval.excludes: free values -> get_inputs; action without consent -> call the executor.

undo_last_turn.author_gloss: cancel all reversible operations of the last user turn.

unrepresentable_reasons.ambiguous_intent: More than one incompatible analysis remains.
unrepresentable_reasons.missing_required_information: The requested intent lacks information needed to form a typed structure.
unrepresentable_reasons.mixed_root_kinds: System control and ordinary operation cannot share the exclusive root.
unrepresentable_reasons.no_actionable_intent: The utterance contains no independently actionable request.
unrepresentable_reasons.outside_registry: The meaning is understood but has no reviewed registry entry.
unrepresentable_reasons.unsupported_dependency: The requested data or control dependency is outside version 0.1.
